name: vex
description: Local code search for agents: symbols, usages, call graph, AST patterns, grep and semantic search
long_description: vex indexes a repository locally with tree-sitter and exposes exact symbol lookup, type-aware usages, call graph, AST pattern search, content grep and semantic search to the agent. Nothing leaves the machine. Set the project root to the repository you want searched; individual tool calls can still pass their own project_root.
